workarounds.symptom: pr-watch: shutdown returns while state-writing threads are still active
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(pr-watch): drain state writers and child processes before shutdown returns. Target files: skills/pr-watch/scripts/pr_watch.py, tests/skills/pr-watch/pr_watch.test.py, docs/README.md. **Level:** medium **Reason:** an existing shutdown race has failed Python shard 6 in two consecutive CI runs of #6376. (Ref: https://github.com/sonichi/sutando/pull/6380)
